sourceReview.scope: Bounded author review of exact two staged files; no independent execution or review inferred

implemented: Functional private four-purpose native partition protocol/codec/lifecycle adapter, structurally incompatible with admitted ChildScopedDataPort; constructor-owned actual native transport not supplied
boundaries: openPartition issues only an opaque local partition capability; no parent/PIN/profile/package/current-rights admission
Private readPartition/comparePartition methods and partitionLease/mayPublish requests cannot structurally substitute for ChildScopedDataPort
mayPublish controls local results only; actual native commit may precede false publication or lost acknowledgement
A separately authenticated host-current binding under the native durable commit lock is still required for admitted index ports
Transport must map actual private native Lease/Cancellation/CAS/retirement under native lock; no default factory or public plugin exists
Abort/timeout settles caller promptly; pending native job holds capacity until its actual completion
Host must erase its views before lifecycle/account/profile/route changes; no frame or App wiring claim
Canonical UTF8 envelope budget is checked incrementally before whole-envelope stringify/encode
Transferred byte cleanup uses bounded own data-descriptors independently of decoder acceptance; 64 slots and 32MiB maximum; no arbitrary malformed object traversal
sourceReviewRepairs: Distinct private partition-only API/types replace the incorrect ChildScopedDataPort claim and cast
Activation-issued capability revokes even never-used A-to-B-to-A requests
Unknown-field/malformed response denial still erases bounded transferred valid byte fields without getters
Request bindings are reread after mayPublish and the final clock sample to deny synchronous field mutation
Aggregate exact canonical UTF8 budget rejects oversized entry projections before full-envelope allocation
Focused tests retain all existing semantics, compile-time non-admission, malformed cleanup and final callback/clock mutation, plus one aggregate-budget case
